takeaways: Auditable ESG rests on four system properties: immutability, reproducibility, lineage and separation of duties.
Calculations belong in a governed Fabric or Synapse zone with versioned emissions factors bound to each closed period, while Power BI stays a thin presentation layer.
Corrections must be approved, additive adjustments rather than overrides, with Entra roles and Purview lineage providing the evidence auditors ask for.
hook: ESG numbers that live in edited spreadsheets and DAX measures will not survive an audit. This episode gives data architects and sustainability teams a replicable Microsoft Cloud blueprint, from immutable ADLS storage and versioned emissions factors to Purview lineage and Entra role separation, so every KPI can be proven end to end.
